dialogs.text: I'll give it a go.
Alright. If you do manage to gather them, please bring them to me.
Found all three.
You... actually managed to put them together? Please, let me see... Indeed, these three patterns, when put together, do tell the story of Azhdaha.
This crane must be the adeptus Mountain Shaper, and this deer might be Moon Carver. But this last one...
Eh? It seems like this pattern has been... intentionally ground away by someone, to the point where I can't make it out. Who was this third adeptus?
Forget it. These matters are beyond my knowledge. Regardless, this treasure is complete, and will definitely sell well.
So, would you like to take it for a keepsake, or would you prefer to sell it to me? I'll pay you a pretty sum.
It's yours.
Great. Please take this, then.
Still, why was the image of one of the three adepti marred?
Who made this thing, and who broke it and ground away the adeptus' image?
Right, it seems as if Soraya has arrived in Liyue. I could write her a letter... she would definitely be interested in this object.
Regarding the Nameless Treasure...
This thing you've brought... It looks pretty good. This pattern also seems quite old indeed. Hold on while I open it.
There are some defects here and there, but if you're eager to have it taken off your hands, I can offer you a price. It'll be fair, but it won't be high.
I just had a look at this one. These markings are definitely those of Liyue, and you can see inscribed here an anecdote about Azhdaha.
They say that Azhdaha was a dragon spawned by a convergence of the spirits of Geo in Liyue, and that even Rex Lapis could not easily subdue it.
Rex Lapis thus summoned three adepti to his aid, and together they created a cavernous realm.
Rex Lapis then battled the creature, luring it into the realm, before ordering the adepti to seal the entrance, trapping Azhdaha within.
The patterns on the thing you brought seem to describe the three adepti joining hands to create the cavernous realm.
I guess that there should at least be three relics of this kind. Combining all three should give us the complete item.
You know all this...
Well, I do trade in items of all kinds. A little general knowledge here and there couldn't hurt.
Ah, but I digress. As I said earlier, there should be three of this item. One of them alone is likely not going to fetch a high price.
But if you could gather all three, that would be a different story. But this looks to be quite ancient. Gathering all three might be too tall a task...
Liyue truly is a mystical place...
Now this I'm not certain of, but a senior of mine once told me that Liyue is too large, and its history is, similarly, far too long.
Don't be surprised if you find strange relics in Liyue. What we know of Liyue's lengthy history is but a single drop in the wide ocean.
Regarding the Nameless Treasure...
If my guess isn't off, the object you brought previously is one of three.
It will only be complete once all three objects are gathered together.
If you could find them all, I would be more than willing to make you a generous offer.
I fear that they may be from too ancient a time, however, and that gathering them... could be difficult.
I'll give it a go.
